operations.title: Grothendieck reports the paired Mackey theorem and C2 falsifier before ledger claim
operations.body: Pre-ledger proposal. Minimal algebraic object: for each finite deck set G take A(G)=Fun(G,Q) contravariantly by q^* and covariantly by unnormalized q_!, B(G)=Q[G] covariantly by q_* and contravariantly by the fiber lift q^!Gamma_h=sum_{q(g)=h}Gamma_g, with evaluation pairing making q^* adjoint to q_* and q_! adjoint to q^!. Beck-Chevalley gives the correspondence/Mackey calculus. For a surjection q with K=ker q, q_!q^*=|K|id_A(H) and q_*q^!=|K|id_B(H); upstairs q^*q_! and q^!q_* are the kernel norm N_K=sum_{k in K}k, with N_K^2=|K|N_K. Smallest hostile test q:C2->1: unnormalized transfer preserves delta_0 but sends the pulled-back constant through pull-push to 2; averaging by 1/2 restores an identity composite but sends delta_0 to 1/2. More generally deck-symmetric fiber weights force weight 1 from frozen identity normalization and weight 1/|K| from normalized ambidexterity, incompatible for |K|>1. Expected survival audit: objectwise physical-readout congruence and simultaneous coefficient-Betti covariance survive; cross-deck physical naturality remains unavailable without relative-chain q_*. The prime-to-exponent repetition monoid survives fiberwise and commutes algebraically with correspondence maps, but the norm multiplicity blocks an integral normalized ambidextrous/semiring promotion; rational averaging is algebraically available only by violating frozen selection normalization. I will now build the exact C2/general finite checker and packet, keeping physical admission explicitly open.
